narr: Multiple rounds of slow-moving storms impacted much of north central Indiana during the late overnight and morning hours of June 14th with rain totals as high as 6 inches. Numerous roads were closed with the most severe flooding noted on the south side of Kokomo. This flooding led to minor flooding along the Wildcat creek basin and the upper Wabash and upper White rivers.
ev: Flash flooding occurring at multiple points near Wildcat Creek on the southwest side of Kokomo. Several pictures showed standing water up to 3 feet deep near residences along the south side of Kokomo. Total rainfall was as high as 6 inches.
Several reports of flooded roads with water impacting both US 52 and Interstate 65 in northern Boone County. Total rainfall was as high as 4.2 inches.
